title: Tenure Relief for Long-Serving Shoppers on Wrong-Address Points — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** For a wrong-address violation booked on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the tenure relief counts the calendar days from the account's first activation date to the day the violation is booked: 1095 days or more earn a relief of 2 points; from 365 up to 1094 days (one fewer than 1095) earn a relief of 1 point; fewer earn no relief.

The first activation date is the activation date recorded on the contractor account.

## Relief bands

| Calendar days from first activation to the booking day | Tenure relief |
|---|---|
| 1095 or more | 2 points |
| 365 to 1094 | 1 point |
| 0 to 364 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Days of tenure on the booking day | Relief |
|---|---|
| 1095 | 2 points |
| 1094 | 1 point |
| 365 | 1 point |
| 364 | None |

An account first activated on 10 March and booked a violation on 10 March of the following year, a year of 365 days, has 365 days of tenure and earns 1 point.
